description: Age field stored primarily as integers. Contains 30 records with 0 missing values. Values range from -5 to 66 years. Contains one text representation ('Twenty-five') that cannot be parsed as a number, and two values (-5 and 4) that appear unrealistic for service accounts.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert the text representation to numeric format: 'Twenty-five' → '25' (3.3% of records).
[CLARIFY] Confirm whether age values -5 and 4 are valid entries or data entry errors, as they fall outside realistic expectations for service accounts.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values are positive integers within a realistic age range (e.g., 13 to 120 years).
